result.summary: Transfer MSG01002 (ENC-T1 to WARD-B) failed with 503 ward_unavailable. There is no receipt (404) and no later events. The receiver shows ENC-T1 admitted at WARD-A, v1, epoch 33, so the transfer is due and allowed. But the route reports conditional_writes=false, so a resend can't be guarded on v1. Escalate to a person under E8.
preconditions: Receiver still at ENC-T1 version 1, state admitted, ward WARD-A, epoch 33
Route capability profile still reports conditional_writes=false (if it becomes true, re-plan as a resend conditional on the current version)

disagreements.said: resend (the message conforms and the 503 was not caused by content)
disagreements.why_kept: Conformance is not in doubt. But the route has conditional_writes=false, so the resend RP-2.1 requires can't be made. The specialist noted this too.

disagreements.said: resend (the transfer still holds and nothing supersedes it)
disagreements.why_kept: The intent is confirmed, but a resend can't be conditioned on v1 while conditional_writes=false. E8 prefers escalate, and the specialist deferred that decision to the gate or a person.

result.why: E8 preferred: without conditional writes a resend would be a blind write that could overwrite changes made since the snapshot (RP-2.1, WIC-7). The E8 alternative, an unconditional resend, needs a person's approval and a manual state check. This plan doesn't do that.
